Marcus / Tessa —

Attached is the first consolidated draft of itineraries for the HelixBank executive workshop in Amsterdam (May 22–24). Aurora pulled three connection options per delegate and flagged the ones with the fastest in-country arrival windows. Highlights: 

- Two execs (Jules Kramer, Joanna) have short connection buffers (<= 75 mins) — flagged as high priority for rebooking or routing via AMS direct.

2) Tessa to confirm hotel check-in windows so we can align flight arrivals.

- For execs traveling from LHR we can request priority transfer on arrival (meet-and-greet) for an added EUR 45 per person.

I’ve left the seat assignments open — you’ve got the best overview on VIP seating.

Thanks — couple of decisions and asks below.

Decisions:
- Approve rebooking Jules to earlier LH (pay fee) to ensure 2-hour buffer. Go ahead with the EUR 210 cost.
- Approve arrival priority transfers from LHR for the three device-carrying execs (add the EUR 45 each).

Asks / follow-ups:
1) Naomi — please confirm the final VIP roster (names + mobile) by COB Friday so Aurora can add meet-and-greet notes.
2) Sophie — can you also provide a short fallback plan per PNR: (A) alternate flight same day, (B) overnight hold + next morning? We need these documented in the event of cancellations.
3) Tessa — we’ll need a simple pick-up matrix: which execs require direct-to-hotel vs. bus transfer. I can share hotel check-in cutoff later today.

Also — please make sure ticketing includes standard corporate waiver (flex for reissue within 24h) where possible. If any PNRs can’t carry the waiver, flag them so we can elevate to procurement for exception.

Thanks — I’ll review the final PNRs once we have the confirmed costs.
